name: Glyphic Runemaster's first spec-row talent is a free node by design (#5269)
contract: Issue #5269 ('War Knight of Xoroth and Gylphic Runemaster Get Their 1st Spec Talent for Free') already has knight-spec-tree-free-nodes.json proving the Knight of Xoroth half of this is CharacterAdvancement design, not a bug: a tree's identity passive and first-row node both carry AbilityEssenceCost 0 / TalentEssenceCost 0 and are granted automatically on specialization choice. This scenario proves the same thing for the Runemaster half. ChrSpecs.dbc id 62 (ClassToken SPIRITMAGE, TabToken ARCANE -- the Glyphic spec) has IdentityEntry 4061, CharacterAdvancement 4061 (RankSpell[0] 92152, AbilityEssenceCost 0, TalentEssenceCost 0): the Frost Glyph identity passive. CharacterAdvancement 66733 (RequiredEntry[0] 4061, RankSpell[0] 801179, AbilityEssenceCost 0, TalentEssenceCost 0) is the free first-row node hanging off that identity -- the Glyphic equivalent of Knight War's Warbringer. Both the identity and the first-row node must be granted automatically on choosing the Glyphic specialization, and switching away must remove both while granting the new spec's own identity (CharacterAdvancement 4062, RankSpell[0] 92153, for the Runic spec, ChrSpecs id 61).

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
Glyphic grants its identity, Frost Glyph
CONTRACT: Glyphic grants its free first row node (CharacterAdvancement 66733, cost 0/0)
Switching to Runic grants its own identity
The switch removed Glyphic's free first row node
